calibration_note_en: Coordinates re-read from the rendered image 2026-09-23. The main doors are a projecting porch in the south (left) wall. The public gallery does not read clearly: only a curved verdigris iron screen stands in the south-west corner. The officers' door and the herald's step are not drawn, so their xy is the Bible position, not a measured one. The jury-box is drawn at floor level, with no visible raised floor.
